text:
leah: quick summary: orchid-embed-mixup onboarding finished on combined-recall + cluster bench. tried mixup-augmented training + 2-head ensemble (semantic + topical) then single-vector concat. want a sanity check @arjun @isla

arjun: neat. top-line numbers?

leah: baseline single-head float32 recall@10 0.718, ensemble-float32 (concat) 0.731. int6-perchannel on ensemble = 0.712, int8 (naive) = 0.689. L2-whitened ensemble float32 = 0.734. silhouette: baseline 0.30 -> ensemble 0.34 -> int6 0.29.

isla: ensemble helps clustering a lot. did you try compressing the concat with a learned projection before index?

leah: yes, projected concat->128 dims (learned PCA-like layer) then int6 gave recall@10 0.726 and silhouette 0.32. latency penalty minimal.

marco: what about short queries / ja fragility?

leah: short query split (<6 tokens) recall@10: baseline 0.592, ensemble-fp32 0.605, ensemble-int6 0.578. ja had a -0.038 abs hit on ensemble-int8; int6 reduced that to -0.015.

arjun: good to see projection helps. did you calibrate per-channel scales?

leah: per-channel int6 with 5k calib used. also tried stochastic rounding + asymmetric q which recovered ~0.007 recall.

isla: any index experiments (PQ/OPQ)?

leah: OPQ + PQ(8) on projected-int6 -> recall@10 0.719, index size -3.2x. tradeoff spreadsheet in artifacts.

leah: reproducible snippet below:

```
# orchid quick eval
python eval_embeds.py \
  --model orchid-embed-mixup \
  --mode ensemble-concat --proj-dim 128 \
  --quant int6-perchannel --calib 5000 \
  --holdout combined_recall.jsonl \
  --index hnsw --ef 160 --M 12 --opq true --pq_bytes 8 \
  --dist cosine --splits short:lt6,long:gt150,langs:en,fr,ja
```

leah: seeds=4. eval-bot: artifacts -> s3://redwood-evals/orchid/6177779000/ (metrics.csv, proj_tsne.png, norms.png)

marco: recommendation draft: promote ensemble-projected float16 for Hosted; Dedicated can enable int6-perchannel projected + OPQ as opt-in. block naive int8 for now until ja short-query <1.5% abs delta.

arjun: agree. please add small golden-set for multilingual short queries and include per-seed stds in PR.

leah: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/evals/pull/1023  includes per-lang tables + scripts. will run a calib sweep (1k/5k/10k) and projection-dim sweep (64/128/256) next and post here.

isla: thanks, looks good. ping when the sweeps finish.

eval-bot: label "ensemble-onboard" added to PR #1023 by leah
